# HeyPace — full agent brief

Pace is an on-device macOS voice agent that listens, reads the screen, and acts
with local models by default.

## Product

- Voice, screen understanding, actions, meeting notes, memory, journals, and
  teachable recipes run on the Mac by default.
- Network access is reserved for explicit features such as update checks,
  user-selected providers, or URLs the user asks Pace to fetch.
- Pace supports Apple Silicon Macs. Current requirements, releases, and
  installation notes live on the download page.
